mapper.select: SELECT plan_ym AS "month", sales_tgt_amt AS "sales", oprt_prft_tgt_amt AS "profit", upld_id::bigint AS "uploadId", reg_user_id AS "regUserId", reg_dttm AS "regDttm", mod_user_id AS "modUserId", mod_dttm AS "modDttm" FROM tb_fi_biz_plan WHERE substring(plan_ym,1,4)=lpad(CAST(#{year} AS text),4,'0') AND part_id='ALL' ORDER BY plan_ym
SELECT close_ym AS "month", close_stat_cd AS "status" FROM tb_cl_close WHERE substring(close_ym,1,4)=lpad(CAST(#{year} AS text),4,'0') ORDER BY close_ym

SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'targets',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.plan_ym,p.part_id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM tb_fi_biz_plan p WHERE substring(p.plan_ym,1,4)=lpad(CAST(#{year} AS text),4,'0') AND p.part_id='ALL'), 'closes',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY c.close_ym),'[]'::jsonb) FROM tb_cl_close c WHERE substring(c.close_ym,1,4)=lpad(CAST(#{year} AS text),4,'0')), 'base',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(b) ORDER BY b.aply_bgn_ym),'[]'::jsonb) FROM tb_sy_oper_std b WHERE b.std_cd='CASH_BASE_YM'))::text
SELECT lpad(trunc(std_val)::text,6,'0') FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd='CASH_BASE_YM' ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: upld_id::bigint AS "uploadId",form_type_cd AS "formType",scrn_id AS "screenId",file_nm AS "filename",file_size::bigint AS "size",trgt_ym AS "month",trgt_proj_id AS "projectId",trgt_dstrb_step_cd AS "step",reg_user_id AS "actor",upld_stat_cd AS "status",tot_row_cnt::int AS "totalRows",succ_cnt::int AS "successRows",warn_cnt::int AS "warningRows",err_cnt::int AS "errorRows",aply_dttm AS "appliedAt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_sy_upld WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sy_upld SET tot_row_cnt=#{summary.totalRows},succ_cnt=#{summary.successRows},warn_cnt=#{summary.warningRows},err_cnt=#{summary.errorRows},upld_stat_cd='CHECKED',mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} AND upld_stat_cd='CHECKED'
mapper.select: SELECT rslt_sn::int AS "sequence",rslt_type_cd AS "severity",row_no::int AS "rowNumber",coalesce(col_nm,'') AS "columnName",coalesce(input_val,'') AS "inputValue",rsn_cn AS "reason" FROM tb_sy_upld_err WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} ORDER BY rslt_sn

SELECT DISTINCT substring(trgt_key,1,4)||'-'||substring(trgt_key,5,2) FROM tb_sy_chg_hist WHERE trgt_tbl_nm='TB_FI_BIZ_PLAN' AND chg_type_cd IN ('NEW','UPD') AND split_part(chg_rsn,':',1)='BusinessPlanImport' AND split_part(chg_rsn,':',2)=CAST(#{uploadId} AS text) ORDER BY 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_fi_biz_plan SET sales_tgt_amt=#{sales},oprt_prft_tgt_amt=#{profit},upld_id=#{uploadId},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE plan_ym=#{month} AND part_id='ALL'
UPDATE tb_sy_upld SET upld_stat_cd='APPLIED',aply_dttm=#{now},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} AND upld_stat_cd='CHECKED'
